GBIF Gap Finder — Overview

Integrated Summary of Spatial, Temporal, Taxonomic, and Institutional Gaps

GBIF Gap Finder

July 23, 2026

About

This report summarises the GBIF biodiversity data gap analysis for Dyntaxa, using the national taxonomy backbone as a reference. It synthesises findings across spatial, temporal, taxonomic, and institutional dimensions.

Data sources:

  • Taxonomy backbone: Dyntaxa
  • Grid resolution: EEA 10 km reference grid (EPSG:3035)
  • Analysis date: 2026-07-22
